title: 10-Second Skip Back/Forward for Video Playback (Nice-to-Have)

user_story.value: quickly rewatch or jump ahead without scrubbing

invest_check._note: Independent = false: precondition is UC1a's controls overlay — sequence after UC1. Highly negotiable (nice-to-have).

preconditions: User is viewing a video post or recorded livestream (NOT a live stream)
The controls overlay is visible (revealed per UC1a)
entry_points: A. User taps the player surface to reveal the controls overlay (UC1a)
B. Controls overlay is already visible

platforms._delta: web rapid-tap currently debounces — must change to accumulate (BR-08).

business_rules.statement: Seek/skip (±10s) controls exist only on video/recorded — never on active Live.
Each skip action moves playback by exactly 10 seconds.
Skip clamps at content boundaries — never below 0:00 or past the final frame, and never loops, even mid-burst during rapid taps.
Rapid skip taps accumulate (each tap adds ±10s), but the skip icon always shows the per-tap value (+10 / −10), never the accumulated total.
Play/pause state changes only via explicit user pause/play — skipping is position-only and does not toggle play/pause.
Reaching the final frame enters the end state (paused) — a terminal condition of content playback.
The viewer is never left on a frozen frame with no feedback — interruptions surface an explicit state.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap skip back (−10s) → jumps back 10s, continues
given: a video or recorded LS is playing
the controls overlay is visible
the current position is at least 10 seconds from the start
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the skip-back (−10s) button
then: playback jumps back exactly 10 seconds from the current position

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap skip forward (+10s) → jumps forward 10s, continues
given: a video or recorded LS is playing
the controls overlay is visible
the current position is at least 10 seconds from the end
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the skip-forward (+10s) button
then: playback jumps forward exactly 10 seconds from the current position

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Skip back <10s from start → 0:00, prior state preserved
given: a video / recorded LS
the current position is less than 10 seconds into the video
then: playback jumps to 0:00 — it does not go to a negative position
the prior playback state is preserved — if playing it continues from 0:00; if paused it stays paused (a boundary skip-back does NOT force a pause)
acceptance_criteria._delta: Jira AC-03 still says 'the video is in a paused state' — our spec corrects to preserve-state (AMB-11); PM to align Jira (FU-5).

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Skip forward <10s from end → final frame, end state (paused)
given: a video / recorded LS
the current position is within 10 seconds of the end
then: playback jumps to the final frame and enters the end state (paused at the final frame — there is no content past the end to continue into)
it does not loop or error

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Skip while paused → position updates, stays paused
given: the video is paused
the controls overlay is visible
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps either skip button
then: the video remains paused — skip does not auto-resume playback

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Live stream → skip buttons not shown (in-app)
given: a 'Live' stream is playing
the controls overlay is visible
then: the skip back / skip forward buttons are not shown — seeking is not applicable on a Live stream (in-app)
acceptance_criteria._note: Scope = in-app buttons only. Android OS-native media-control scrub on Live = separate bug (FU-4), not this AC.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Rapid repeated skip taps → accumulate ±10s; icon shows ±10
given: a video / recorded LS is playing
the controls overlay is visible
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps a skip button multiple times quickly (e.g. skip-forward ×3 at 1:00)
then: each tap adds 10 seconds to the total (→ 1:30) — taps accumulate
the skip icon does not show the accumulated total — it always shows +10 or -10
acceptance_criteria._delta: web currently debounces to a single ±10s — must change to accumulate (BR-08).

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Rapid skip taps near start/end → obey boundary rules mid-burst
given: the user taps a skip button multiple times quickly near the start or end of the video
acceptance_criteria.when: a tap would move playback past 0:00 or past the final frame
then: that tap follows the boundary rules (AC-03 / AC-04) — it does not go to a negative position or loop, even mid-burst

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Default — no skip buttons before the overlay is revealed
given: a video / recorded LS is loaded and the controls overlay has not yet been revealed (per UC1a)
then: no skip buttons are visible — they appear only as part of UC1a's controls overlay
acceptance_criteria._note: Ties UC3's default state to UC1a's overlay lifecycle — confirms the build-order dependency (UC1a → UC3).

given: the video is buffering at the current position (mobile)
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps a skip button
then: playback seeks and rebuffers at the target position — no stuck loading, no crash

given: the video is buffering at the current position (web)
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps a skip button
then: [PENDING FU-3] the exact behaviour of the ±10s button mid-buffer on web is not yet confirmed
[known] the player separately shows a 'Reconnecting' UI + allows manual scrub/scroll — a different gesture from tapping the ±10s skip
